_doc: Semantic notes per table, given to the Planner and SQL agent. Domain documentation, not answers.
whybot.yellow_daily: Zetaris SchemaStore view (cached) over NY_TAXI.yellow_taxi (real NYC TLC yellow trips): one row per day 2024-04-01..2025-02-28. trip_date DATE, trips = trip count, avg_total_amount = mean total_amount USD per trip, avg_trip_distance = mean miles. Fast. Use for the metric, weekday baselines and fare/distance mix.
whybot.nyc_weather_daily: Zetaris view over NOAA GHCN-Daily, Central Park station USW00094728 (real, CC0): obs_date DATE (2024-01-01..2025-02-05), prcp_mm (mm), snow_mm (mm snowfall), tmax_c, tmin_c (deg C). Join on obs_date = trip_date.
whybot.us_holidays: Zetaris view over Nager.Date REST (real US holidays 2024-2025): holiday_date DATE, holiday_name, is_national (true = federal, false = state-only). The authoritative holiday source.
TPCDS_DB.date_dim: TPC-DS calendar: d_date DATE, d_day_name, d_dow (0=Sunday), d_weekend ('Y' on Fri and Sat in this build), d_holiday ('Y'/'N'). d_holiday is SYNTHETIC and unreliable; use it only to flag data-quality disagreements with whybot.us_holidays. Use d_day_name for weekdays.
NY_TAXI.yellow_taxi: Raw real TLC yellow trips (38.7M rows, all columns STRING, cast before arithmetic; pickup date = to_date(substr(tpep_pickup_datetime,1,10))). Uncached scan ~170 s: at most one narrow query. Contains outlier timestamps (2002, 2026).
NY_TAXI.yellow_tripdata: DEV-ONLY sample: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips Jan-Feb 2024, one row per trip.
NOAA_GHCN_S3.noaa_ghcn_daily_2024: DEV-ONLY sample: NOAA GHCN-Daily long format (ID station, DATE yyyymmdd int, ELEMENT PRCP tenths mm / SNOW mm / TMAX,TMIN tenths C, DATA_VALUE). Filter ID='USW00094728' (Central Park).
